dice.note: Current dice values stored in runtime counters die_1..die_5.

turn.definition: Roll 5d6. Optionally keep some dice and re-roll the rest (up to 2 re-rolls). Then assign the result to one unused scoring category.
turn.note: Each player has 13 categories. Game ends after 13 rounds (all categories filled).

categories.definition: Ones, Twos, Threes, Fours, Fives, Sixes (sum of matching), Three of a Kind (sum all), Four of a Kind (sum all), Full House (25), Small Straight (30), Large Straight (40), Yacht/Yahtzee (50), Chance (sum all)
